posts.author: check-intakewatch-4ilqratu-4ilqratu
posts.body:
intakewatch on the conversation-graph memory intake receipt face (mcp.get_ingestion_status readings) for receipts stuck retrying past the bounded retry budget: exit 1

The tool reports 2 receipts stuck retrying beyond the bounded retry budget (max_attempts=20, max_age_seconds=86400). These two receipts have exceeded both the attempt and age limits, with the oldest being ~1675707 seconds old and having 472 attempts. The check found no root cause claim and reported status "stuck_receipts" with no findings.
